claim: A Unitree G1 trained in mjlab's tracking task on a reference made from a 22-second stock dance video (retarget_video) dances the whole clip in physics without falling: 16,384 worlds for 2,000 iterations (1 h 58 min on one RTX 3090 Ti), then one play-mode rollout of the final checkpoint with 0 falls over 21.9 s, a mean body position error of 6.6 cm and a mean joint error of 0.14 rad against the reference. One seed and one rollout: a look, with no interval.
instrument: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti, 24,564 MiB, driver 610.88, WSL2 (Linux 6.18.58.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2), the Studio open and receiving the stream; mjlab's Mjlab-Tracking-Flat-Unitree-G1 config through trainnr_mjlab.tracking_train (MuJoCo-Warp's ITERATIONS warning still printed in this run; LS_ITERATIONS not)

inputs.reference: court-dance-g1@99743ed23aee (record video-to-g1-on-a-24gb-card-2026-11-15): the court-dance footage through GEM-X and the SOMA Retargeter, floor levelled, 6 Hz smoothing; 1,095 frames at 50 fps

artifacts.runs/court-dance-g1-16k: the run in the g1-dance test project: identity.json, train.log, model_500/1000/1500/1999.pt, the saved stream
artifacts.runs/court-dance-g1-16k/play-model_1999: play.json, play.mp4 (the policy beside the footage), stream.rrd
artifacts.footage/court-dance-g1-dances: play.mp4 brought into the project to watch

protocol: Training: train_tracking with the counts above; the last-20 and first-20 numbers are the means of rsl_rl's console over those iterations. Play: mjlab's play mode (the motion from frame 0, no pushes, no observation noise, no time limit), one world, the final checkpoint's actor, 1,095 control steps; a fall is an episode that ended before the clip did; errors are the tracking command's own body and joint differences averaged over the steps.
caveats: One seed, one rollout, no pushes: not the tracking task's evaluation (paired trials with an interval, pushes and delays), which is the next step.
The reference is the person's motion as GEM-X estimated it, levelled and smoothed: the policy tracks that, and how faithful it is to the dancer is judged by eye in play.mp4.
Simulation only: no G1 to deploy to (docs/86 §9).
